data.name: Legend of Hand
data.detailed_description:
Check out our latest game!


Acerca do jogo

Legend of Hand tells the story of a hero on an epic quest to find the mythical Grandmaster Hand, the one man who can restore peace to a troubled world. Inspired by adventure classics, Far-East legends and martial arts beat 'em up games of the 80's and 90's, this point and click adventure will take the player on a unique journey through magical lands.

STORY:

Your masters have put their trust in you to find the mythical Grandmaster Hand, an enigmatic figure who disappeared many years ago. He is the one man capable of stopping the gathering unrest that is threatening your world. To find Hand you will need to travel through four mysterious islands, finding clues and challenging their infamous masters - the so-called Fingers of Hand! The masters are experts in martial arts and finding them will be not always be easy.

Your quest will take you on an epic adventure across unique islands and weird worlds where you will meet amazing friends and terrifying foes. So many distractions await but do not forget your aim - find Grandmaster Hand to save your world and its inhabitants!

Can you reunite a troubled world? Can you find the elusive Grandmaster Hand? Your destiny awaits...

FEATURES:

  • An epic quest spanning many wonderful lands. Expect 10+ hours of gameplay!
  • An impressive cast of intriguing, bizarre, amusing and lovable characters. Expect to meet companions who will aid and follow you in your adventures!
  • Traditional point and click adventure game elements such as puzzles, inventory system and dialogue interactions.
  • Unique hand drawn graphics and animations.
  • A turn-based RPG style fighting system that is easy to learn and fun to play. Learn new combat moves, increase your HP and fight enemies.
  • Mini games galore! Many of these are skippable or optional, if mini games aren't your cup of tea!
  • Animated cut scenes.
  • Original soundtrack reflecting the atmosphere of the special worlds visited by the hero.

reviews.review:
Legend of Hand is an imaginative point-and-click adventure that combines martial arts mythology, traditional puzzle-solving, light role-playing elements, and an entertaining sense of humor. Developed and published by Cloak and Dagger Games, it draws inspiration from classic adventure titles while introducing distinctive mechanics that give the experience its own personality. Rather than focusing on sophisticated graphics or action-heavy gameplay, it emphasizes exploration, character interactions, creative puzzles, and a memorable journey through a peculiar fantasy world.

The story follows a young martial artist tasked with finding the legendary Grandmaster Hand, a mysterious master who disappeared many years ago. His mission takes him across four unique islands, where he must seek out powerful martial arts masters known as the Fingers of Hand. Along the way, he encounters unusual inhabitants, dangerous opponents, and unexpected challenges. Although the narrative follows a familiar heroic journey, its eccentric humor and imaginative situations prevent it from feeling overly conventional.

Exploration is one of the game's strongest features. Each island introduces different environments, personalities, and obstacles that encourage players to investigate their surroundings carefully. Progression depends on gathering information, examining objects, interacting with characters, and understanding how different discoveries connect. The world feels deliberately strange, creating an enjoyable atmosphere where even seemingly ordinary encounters can lead to surprising developments.

The point-and-click mechanics follow traditional adventure-game conventions. Players collect items, manage their inventory, engage in conversations, and solve puzzles to advance the story. Many challenges require observation and experimentation rather than quick reflexes. This makes the experience accessible to players who enjoy thoughtful gameplay, although certain solutions may occasionally feel obscure. Those unfamiliar with older adventure games might experience moments of frustration when the next objective is not immediately apparent.

An especially interesting feature is the inclusion of turn-based combat. Unlike conventional point-and-click adventures that concentrate almost entirely on puzzles, Legend of Hand incorporates RPG-inspired battles that complement its martial arts setting. Players can improve their character's abilities, learn additional fighting moves, and increase their health throughout the journey. Combat remains relatively straightforward, making it approachable without overwhelming players with complicated systems. However, anyone expecting the strategic complexity of a dedicated role-playing game may find these encounters somewhat simplistic.

The adventure also includes optional activities and minigames that provide variety between exploration and combat sequences. These diversions help maintain an entertaining pace while reinforcing the game's playful personality. The ability to skip certain activities is particularly welcome, allowing players to concentrate on the main adventure without being forced to complete every secondary challenge.

Character interactions contribute significantly to the experience. The world contains an assortment of amusing, mysterious, and occasionally bizarre personalities who provide information, assistance, or additional obstacles. Some companions can accompany the protagonist, making the journey feel less isolated. The dialogue frequently embraces humor and absurdity, creating memorable situations that distinguish the game from more serious fantasy adventures.

Visually, Legend of Hand features charming hand-drawn artwork and animations that complement its nostalgic design. Its environments and characters prioritize artistic personality over technical sophistication. Animated cutscenes add variety to the storytelling, while the colorful presentation reinforces the whimsical atmosphere. Although the graphics may appear modest compared with contemporary productions, their handcrafted quality suits the game's independent identity.

The original soundtrack further enhances the adventure by establishing atmosphere across its different locations. Music complements the exploration, dialogue, and unusual encounters without overwhelming the experience. Together with the illustrated environments and character designs, it creates a cohesive presentation that supports the game's lighthearted fantasy setting.

Regarding content and longevity, the game offers more than ten hours of advertised gameplay, providing a substantial adventure for players who enjoy exploring every location and solving optional challenges. Its combination of puzzles, conversations, combat, and minigames helps prevent excessive repetition. Steam achievements and trading cards provide additional incentives, although the experience is primarily designed around a single-player narrative rather than extensive replayability.

Steam Deck compatibility remains officially unconfirmed, as the Steam store does not display a Verified or Playable classification for the game. Its modest hardware requirements suggest that performance should not be particularly demanding, but successful operation through SteamOS and Proton cannot be guaranteed. The point-and-click interface may also require touchscreen interaction or customized trackpad controls. Players interested in portable gaming should therefore approach Steam Deck support with reasonable caution.

Despite its strengths, Legend of Hand may not appeal to everyone. Some puzzles can interrupt the pacing, the combat lacks extensive tactical depth, and its retro-inspired presentation may feel outdated to players accustomed to modern adventures. Nevertheless, these limitations are balanced by its creative storytelling, entertaining characters, and varied gameplay mechanics.

Overall, Legend of Hand is a delightful independent adventure that successfully combines nostalgic point-and-click gameplay with martial arts fantasy and accessible RPG elements. Its imaginative environments, amusing dialogue, handcrafted visuals, and rewarding exploration make it an enjoyable choice for enthusiasts of classic adventure games. While its mechanics occasionally reveal their old-fashioned influences, its creativity and distinctive personality make the journey worthwhile.

A charming, humorous, and creatively designed adventure that offers an enjoyable combination of exploration, puzzles, martial arts combat, and memorable storytelling.

Rating: 8/10
